test_title: PYST 186: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If the ratio of the present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar is 2 ∶ 1, and 15 years ago the ratio of their ages was 3 ∶ 1, then the present age (in years) of Shikha is:
solution:
Given, Ratio of present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar = 2 :1

Let us consider present ages of Shikha and Rajkumar = 2x : x

15 years ago the ratio of their ages was = 3 ∶ 1

Hence,

(2x - 15) / (x - 15) = 3 / 1

2x - 15 = 3(x - 15)

2x - 15 = 3x - 45

3x - 2x = 45 - 15

∴ x = 30

Thus, the present age of Shikha = 2x = 2 × 30 = 60 years

Hence, the correct answer is **"60".**
